SWSH Black Star Promos

Released November 15, 2019 · 304 cards

StandardExpanded

SWSH Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on November 15, 2019. It has 304 cards. It includes 292 Pokémon, 12 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
